channel.title: Tuned blog
channel.description: News, guides and what's new in Tuned.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.17.0
item.description: Tuned 2.17.0 is out. New accounts get Getting to know Tuned, a short daily email about one feature at a time, which you can turn off in your account.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.16.1
item.description: Tuned 2.16.1, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Signing in on a TV with your phone now opens Tuned straight away on copies from Google Play.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.16.0
item.description: Tuned 2.16.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Live events from channel names when the guide is empty, Simkl history import, and a fuller Report a problem.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.15.0

item.description: Connect a home media server to Tuned for Live TV, films and shows, with the server's own guide when it has one.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.4.1

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.4.0
item.description: Tuned 2.4.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. The filters you pick on Live TV, Movies and Shows stay picked, even after Tuned closes, and each profile keeps its own.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.3.1
item.description: Tuned 2.3.1, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Home no longer freezes while your Movies and Shows load and sort.

item.title: What's new in Tuned 2.3.0
item.description: Tuned 2.3.0, the IPTV player for Android and Android TV, is out. Who's watching opens faster, the TV remote starts on the first profile, and your Movies and Shows sort stays put.
